title: wg: protocol-06 §5.4.1.2 hub_key length and rotation unspecified
description: Suggestion. §5.4.1.2 keys server_frank with hub_key but never states its length or management; §5.9 'selects its relevant hub_key' implies rotation, yet nothing in Frank or AbuseReport identifies which key was used; §9.1 Franking is 'TBD'. mimid uses a fixed 32-byte local key (decision mimid-1wgh.5.53). Fix: state key length, and add a key identifier (or epoch/time rule) so the hub can select the key when verifying a report.
